item.title: Callous Approach by CIT(A) for Summarily Dismissing Appeal: ITAT Restores Appeal Dismissed Over Mere Clerical Error [Read Order]
item.description: The Bench urged CBDT to look into such growing instances of first appellate authorities summarily dismissing appeals in a casual and negligent manner

item.title: NCLAT sets aside Dismissal of S. 95 IBC Pleas Filed by Canara Bank against Personal Guarantors[Read Order]
item.description: The Bench observed that the adjudicatory function of the Tribunal commences only after the RP submits a report under Section 99 and the Tribunal proceeds under Section 100

item.title: Repayment of Rs. 1.85 Cr Loan in Two Days alone Does not Prove its Paper Entry: Delhi HC Upholds Deletion of S. 68 Addition [Read Order]
item.description: The court upheld ITAT’s deletion of Section 68 addition, holding that repaying ₹1.85 crore loan in two days alone does not make it a paper entry.

item.title: No Grounds to Interfere with Order Admitting S. 95 Application: NCLAT upholds Insolvency Proceedings against Personal Guarantors [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal reiterated that Section 10A does not apply to proceedings under Section 95 of the Code

item.title: FinMin Increases Customs Tariff Values for Gold and Silver [Read Notification]
item.description: CBIC has increased customs tariff values for gold to US$ 1605 per 10 grams and silver to US$ 2934 per kg, effective from 6 February 2026

item.title: NCLAT Upholds Admission of SBI’s Rs.116 Crore Claim, Dismisses Appeals by Suspended Director [Read Order]
item.description: The Bench observed that suspended director could not regard bank’s claim as time-barred after corporate debtor had voluntarily invoked S. 10 based on admitted dues of SBI

item.title: No Separate Application Needed for Condonation of Delay if Cause is Evident: NCLAT Rejects Appeal [Read Order]
item.description: Relying upon Supreme Court guidelines in an earlier precedent, the Tribunal observed that the statute permits condonation of delay even in the absence of a formal application

item.title: Supreme Court Dismisses CBDT SLPs against Telangana HC Order Quashing Income Tax Notices issued to Telangana Pollution Control Board [Read Judgement]
item.description: The Supreme Court refused to interfere with Telangana High Court order granting relief to Telangana Pollution Control Board against Income Tax Department actions.

item.title: SFIO-SEBI Findings on NSEL-CCM Scam Not Enough for additions when Trades are Fully Disclosed: ITAT
item.description: The additions were deleted on the ground that the same transactions had already been accounted for and taxing them again would amount to duplication, decided the ITAT.

item.title: Only Final Stamp Valuation Determined by Collector Applies u/s 50C: ITAT allows Full Section 54F Exemption [Read Order]
item.description: The Tribunal noted that in the co‑owner’s case (Naresh Shrivastava), relief had already been granted on identical facts, and therefore parity required the same treatment here.
